dogecoin.text: In December bought a bag of $Doge worth a paycheck. Today that bag is worth 5X more and my actual paycheck decreased! In a month a bag of Doge outperformed 160 attorney hours!! 🤣

Last spring someone tweeted he found 1MM Doge coin on an old laptop. At the time Doge was over 150 sats ~ 1.5 BTC. I thought he was trolling and that no one would forget that amount of money. Welp... That could be us in 1-2 yrs 🤣
